narrative.description: Full narrative body for the entity record (third-person, arc-preserving, uses {{principal}} role token for the user).

arc_note.description: 1-2 sentences summarising what was added or changed relative to the prior story.

significance.description: Durable importance of the entity's accumulated story, using the documented rubric in the prompt.

significance_rationale.description: Brief evidence-based reason for the selected significance.

summary.description: Concise frontmatter summary based on the updated narrative. Carry relational/legal nuance, or explicitly defer with 'see narrative for full context' when a single-valued summary would flatten the situation.
